rulingProvenance.notChanged: This registration touches no engine / tests / tools / cmake source and no root CMakeLists.txt. The src-only capability category token named in ownerReviewRequired was renamed to capability_disabled by the parallel implementation line, not by this task.

srcOnlyPolicyNote: The thirteen judgement.s7a2.* tokens carry status=not_registered_src_only. That status word is intentionally NOT a pending marker: the 2026-10-02T21:03:39.462Z card (adopt 0.96) ruled that all thirteen stay src-only and never enter the public code table or the ABI, and that their public projection uses only the registered nine categories and the already registered stable codes. A future reader must not treat not_registered_src_only as 'waiting to be registered'.
statusNote: Round-6 registration of the Gameplay V2 diagnostic code table (Codex thread 01a0fe61-3476-7882-9674-5f6b05035237, verdict adopt, confidence 0.97), then the follow-up completion of the same round-6 CM-D04 / P1-09 first consumption (Codex thread 01a0fe6b-6e57-7051-87f8-cf9588e85568, decision card 2026-10-02T21:03:39.462Z, verdict adopt, confidence 0.96; see rulingProvenance below). Every code string in this file is quoted from an existing document; no code and no category is invented here. The category set is the nine V2 categories of GAMEPLAY_V2_SPEC.md 9.2. Eight categories that the first registration marked categoryBasis=derived_pending_owner_confirmation were ruled by the follow-up card and now carry categoryBasis=owner_ruled; geometry.inference_rejected moved from unknown_capability to invalid_relation under that ruling. The severity and faulted value sets are the ones this file declares below; see severitySources and faultedBehaviorSources for their documented basis. The thirteen judgement.s7a2.* tokens are marked status=not_registered_src_only: that status word is deliberate and means explicitly never to be registered, not a pending state - see srcOnlyPolicyNote.
authorityNote: GAMEPLAY_V2_SPEC.md 9.1 owns the four-layer diagnostic model (code / category / severity / faulted) and its category set; GAMEPLAY_V2_ABI.md only consumes them. A diagnostic code string must be registered in this file and pass the CTest gate cuexis_gameplay_diagnostics_codes before it may enter a public header.

categories.name: unknown_capability
categories.note: One of the nine V2 categories. Spec 9.3 lists an unknown capability as an atomic prepare failure condition.

categories.name: capability_disabled
categories.note: One of the nine V2 categories. Spec 9.3 lists a capability that is declared but not enabled as an atomic prepare failure condition; GAMEPLAY_V2_ABI.md domain 8 CapabilityState names the state 'known but not enabled'.

categories.name: budget_exceeded
categories.note: One of the nine V2 categories. Spec 9.3 assigns tick overflow, amount out-of-range, amount narrowing and an enabled-but-under-budget capability to it.

categories.name: ambiguous_migration
categories.note: One of the nine V2 categories. Spec 7.2 assigns it to R-18 and R-19.

categories.name: non_terminating_source
categories.note: One of the nine V2 categories. Spec 9.3 names a non-terminating CXT expansion or unbounded loop as its atomic failure condition.

categories.name: non_unique_solution
categories.note: One of the nine V2 categories. Spec 9.3 names a missing solver profile, an incomplete objective, an exceeded fuel budget or an unprovable unique result as its atomic failure condition.

categories.name: invalid_relation
categories.note: One of the nine V2 categories. Spec 9.3 assigns an incomplete or self-contradicting declaration, a dangling relation reference, an illegal resource state transition and a calibrated session clock reversal to it.

categories.name: late_policy_incomplete
categories.note: One of the nine V2 categories. Spec 9.3 assigns a missing, undeclared or unmeasured late-policy parameter and a duplicate queue entry to it.

categories.name: identity_closure_incomplete
categories.note: One of the nine V2 categories. GAMEPLAY_V2_ABI.md domain 8 records that a declared capability set smaller than the derived closure is a stable failure.

categorySourceNote: GAMEPLAY_V2_SPEC.md 9.2 freezes exactly these nine category names and states that the ten Gameplay I categories of GAMEPLAY_JUDGEMENT_ABI.md section 4 must be merged into them with an old-to-new mapping (CM-D02). That merge mapping is not frozen and is recorded under pendingRegistration, so the Gameplay I names are deliberately not registered as categories here.
severityBasisNote: GAMEPLAY_V2_ABI.md domain 8 still marks DiagnosticSeverity as 'to be frozen (CM-D04)' and GAMEPLAY_V2_SPEC.md 9.1 names the layer without enumerating values. This file therefore registers the repository-wide severity surface that already ships in engine/core/include/cuexis/core/diagnostic.hpp (info / warning / error) instead of inventing a new value set. The 2026-10-02T21:03:39.462Z card (adopt 0.96) confirmed this whole set as the Stage 7A severity value set and confirmed that every stable rejection and atomic failure carries severity=error, so every code registered here is error; info and warning are closed-set members that no registered code uses yet.

faultedBehaviorSources.session_unaffected: GAMEPLAY_V2_SPEC.md#9.3 (a prepare atomic failure must not publish a half-prepared result and must not change the existing active session)
faultedBehaviorSources.session_faulted: GAMEPLAY_V2_SPEC.md#9.4 and gameplay-v2-execution-profile.md#7.3: Ruleset or admitted kernel Tick transaction failure permits query/reset.

faultedBasisNote: The closed behaviors remain session_unaffected and session_faulted. Ruleset transaction failure and the S7A-4 kernel Tick transaction failure are registered faulted paths; prepare and submit failures leave the session unchanged.

codes.note: Newly registered by the 2026-10-02T21:03:39.462Z card (adopt 0.96) as the dedicated stable code of the only runtime faulted path: a second-phase (Ruleset state commit) atomic validation failure. The Tick stays uncommitted, the old state is kept, the Fact Ledger is already committed and cannot be rolled back, no fault Fact is appended and no RuleEffectEvent / PresentationEvent is published; the session moves into the queryable faulted state and stops accepting new judgement mutations. Spec 9.4 now names this code instead of leaving the stable code to be chosen from the existing 9.2 / 9.3 table. It is the only registered code whose faulted value is session_faulted. Its trigger includes a RegisterKind outside the three frozen kinds, a duplicate contribution identity, a non-commutative or non-associative fold, a second exclusive owner or writer, a direct ledger_derived StateDelta write, and a steady-state budget / overflow / conflict validation failure in that phase. It is not a CapabilityRecord.stableRejectCode, so stableRejectCode is null, and it adds no R entry (Spec 7.2 still holds exactly 19).

diagnosticStringPolicy.rule: A string is a public diagnostic code when its named code string, its applicable scenario and its nine-category mapping are unambiguously traceable to one another in the canonical texts. The scenario row and the code-string row may live in different sections (for example Spec 3.7.8 versus Spec 9.3 or ABI), but they must point at each other explicitly. A name prefix (judgement.s7a2.* or otherwise) does not decide publicness, and no owner naming condition is introduced.
diagnosticStringPolicy.publicSurfaceRule: A non-null publicConsumptionSurface marks a public registered code and is carried only by codes[] entries, where it must be a non-empty string. Every pendingRegistration entry carries publicConsumptionSurface: null, whether it is one of the thirteen src-only tokens (status = not_registered_src_only) or an open slot with no code string chosen yet (code = null). A pendingRegistration entry that names a public consumption surface is a table error. The surface count and the pending count are therefore never the same number and neither may be read as "all codes are public".
